Fig1: Study design: the same AI agents analyse biological data in open-ended code or through the Galaxy workbench.
Fig2: Agents reach similar accuracy in Galaxy and in open-ended code, and most of their failures are not caused by Galaxy.
Fig3: Agents use Galaxy as a structured analysis environment whose records reveal input, parameter and silent-substitution errors.
Fig4: Solution paths vary by model and benchmark, and Galaxy replicates agree more often and diverge for different reasons.
Fig5: Galaxy raises input-token use, mostly for finding and inspecting tools, in exchange for an inspectable analysis record.
